authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5301 jyotsnā gives Assamese zonāk/jonāk moonlight. Bishnupriya junak moon fits that extended eastern noun, retaining the shift from moonlight to the moon itself and the affricate/vowel notation. The -ak is supported by the quoted noun, not discarded as noise. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: junak.
